open_points.subject: _encrypt_backup
open_points.text: _encrypt_backup: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST seal under an AES-GCM key of the imported BACKUP_KEY_BYTES constant in bytes, derived by HKDF with the hash of the cryptography package's hashes whose name equals the one the imported BACKUP_KEY_DERIVATION_HASH constant holds, the code naming that hash's class and comparing the built hash's name with the constant, no table of names and no lookup by name, and no salt from the bytes of backup_key with those of the imported BACKUP_KEY_DERIVATION_INFO constant as its info, both encoded by the imported TEXT_ENCODING constant, using the cryptography package, and MUST pass the record line's bytes without its line feed as the associated data, so that a changed record fails the decryption.
open_points.rule: **Fail-closed на обеих сторонах.** Неразмещённое значение останавливает сборку. Подстановка значения в контекст модели «на всякий случай» запрещена: она молча восстанавливает старое поведение и обесценивает шов.
open_points.question: The passage must name an imported concrete hash constructor or an imported provider mapping; requiring the generated code to name a class while the algorithm value is hidden and both lookup and a mapping are forbidden leaves the class selection unplaced and forces the generator to guess.
